headlines.title: Uber Q3 earnings preview: Gross bookings, user growth key for investors as robotaxi spending ramps up
headlines.summary: Uber is scheduled to report third quarter results on Wednesday. Investors expect the ride-hailing giant to post bookings above the midpoint of its own guidance and keep adding users at a double-digit clip.

headlines.title: Uber Q3 profit, revenue beat estimates as gross bookings jump 20%
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Uber on Wednesday beat third-quarter profit and revenue estimates, while its full-year earnings guidance missed analyst expectations at the midpoint.

headlines.title: Uber Stock Rises As Q3 Earnings Beat Despite Slower Bookings Growth
headlines.summary: Uber stock nudged higher after the ride-hailing giant offered third-quarter results ahead of expectations.

headlines.title: Uber (NYSE:UBER) posts Q3 2026 sales in line with estimates
headlines.summary: Ride sharing and on-demand delivery platform Uber (NYSE:UBER) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue up 9.6% year on year to $14.77 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.88 per share was 1.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headlines.title: Uber: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
headlines.summary: SAN FRANCISCO (AP) — SAN FRANCISCO (AP) — Uber Technologies Inc. (UBER) on Wednesday reported third-quarter earnings of $512 million.

description: Uber Technologies, Inc. develops and operates proprietary technology applications in the United States, Canada, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. The company operates through three segments: Mobility, Delivery, and Freight. The Mobility segment connects consumers with a range of transportation modalities, such as ridesharing, carsharing, micromobility, rentals, public transit, taxis, and other modalities; and offers riders in a variety of vehicle types, as well as financial partnerships products and advertising services. The Delivery segment allows consumers to search for and discover restaurants to grocery, alcohol, convenience, and other retailers, as well as order a meal or other items, and either pick-up at the restaurant or have it delivered; and provides Uber direct, a white-label delivery-as-a-service for retailers and restaurants, as well as advertising services. The Freight segment manages transportation and logistics networks, which connects shippers and carriers in digital marketplace, including carriers upfronts, pricing, and shipment booking; and offers on-demand platform to automate logistics end-to-end transactions for small-and medium-sized businesses to global enterprises. Uber Technologies, Inc. has strategic partnership with Mews to embed ride booking, real-time tracking and integrated billing directly into the Mews platform. The company was formerly known as Ubercab, Inc. and changed its name to Uber Technologies, Inc. in February 2011. Uber Technologies, Inc. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
